alerts.description: W/D/L, league points, points for/against, and streak for GW[1, 2] were reconstructed from raw match data (exact — every result is immutable and already stored). Rank is NOT available for these gameweeks: FPL's H2H tiebreak rule for ties has never been empirically verified, so computing a rank would mean asserting an unconfirmed method. Revisit once a future gameweek's real tie lets the tiebreak formula be validated against confirmed data (see SPEC.md §13).
